David is interested in dancing. Tom wrote about the day in the diary. Tom and David had great fun there. Also, basil grows on the windowsill.
There are always many people at the balcony. Tom is reading a book about science. The study room is one of the best places in the city. What's more, these grapes are sweet and juicy.
